lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section but becomes progressively narrower as lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines terminate mid-flank, transitioning into discrete circular spots before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 7-8 high-contrast white spots are clustered on the upper hind limb and haunch with a higher density concentrated near the transition to the torso.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible across the mid-haunch, forming a geometric bridge between vertical lines and the posterior edge.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a nearly straight, slightly divergent trajectory with a minor posterior tilt relative to the frontal bone of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal horn tips is approximately 1.2 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tips comprise approximately the upper 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white transverse band is visible at the base of the neck, accompanied by distinct white spots on the lower cheek and a white chevron between the eyes.
